notes:
REF-BM-02: Title, description, and preview metadata are fetched, but the preview is not persisted and favicon is derived from a third-party URL rather than stored metadata.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but there is no separate note field.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates a duplicate; no convergence or edit guidance exists.
REF-BM-08: Only a small external-link control opens the URL; selecting the card/list item itself does not navigate.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text input without autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable as filters.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, and tags, but not notes or the full URL path.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query parsing is implemented.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator rules are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including quote characters.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: No separate markdown note or rendered bookmark view exists.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot capture exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archive behavior is absent; only deletion exists.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks list exists.
REF-BM-29: Collections are static assignments, not saved dynamic search/tag bundles.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: Export produces JSON rather than Netscape HTML.
REF-BM-32: No persistent personal display settings for default sort, item count, or font size exist.
